description: Campaign 028 production-readiness closure. No new features. The orchestrator owns shared hotspots (.agent/**, openspec/**, scripts/**, docs/**, .github/**, package manifests, registry/generated files, shared component/kit surfaces) and performs all convergence edits plus runtime QA. Two disjoint code packets own the app-surface reliability repairs (W1) and the data-portability robustness closure (W2).

parallelPackets.objective: Surface the remaining silent user-action failures: Home primary workout CTA start, rewards cosmetic purchase/equip, profile milestone/quest/achievement claims; sweep the same screens for the same silent class.
parallelPackets.completionCriteria: Each repaired handler shows a user-visible danger message on rejection and stays retryable; every repair has a route-level test that injects the rejection and asserts the visible handling plus unchanged state; screens under test remain on-route.
parallelPackets.validation: cd apps/mobile && npx tsc --noEmit && npx jest src/app/__tests__/rewards.test.tsx src/app/__tests__/profile-purchases.test.tsx src/app/__tests__/home-workout-start.test.tsx

parallelPackets.objective: Close the portability robustness gaps: single-pass production export via the already-proven exportLocalDataBundle, quest/achievement FK cross-validation, pre-read pick size guard, preview re-entrancy and collision-resistant backup names.
parallelPackets.completionCriteria: Byte-identity suites stay green after the export migration; a cross-FK-invalid backup is rejected with the typed validation error before mutation; oversized declared pick results are rejected before read; repeated same-second exports do not overwrite; preview cannot run concurrently with itself.
parallelPackets.validation: cd apps/mobile && npx tsc --noEmit && npx jest src/data-portability src/app/__tests__/data-management.test.tsx
